chain.text: Domaine des Trois Chênes farms 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc) on clay/flint, averaging 62,000 bottles yearly; 2024 hail cut output to 48,000. Organic since 2019; biodynamic certification possible from 2026. Exports are 41% of sales, mainly Belgium and Japan, whose importer requires sulphites under 60mg/L. Two past failures—a 2022 tank 4 temperature drift (€11,000 loss) and a 2023 label recall—led to controller calibration, a second probe, and dual label signatures. Rules: no irrigation on western plots, harvest decided by three mornings of sugar/acidity readings, and tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Pending: lighter bottles and eastern parcel replanting after 2027.
